normalization.outer: observed noisy RMS only; multiply back after restoration
normalization.training_reference: clean RMS defines unit-power forward synthesis, not input scaling
normalization.backbone_input: noisy/current diffusion state divided by its own RMS
normalization.targets: corresponding clean and noise targets use the same corrupted-state scale
normalization.noise_output: multiply normalized noise by current-state RMS before reverse update

loss: normalized-coordinate epsilon MSE + MAE(t/T); no class or POD loss
scope: Normalization adaptation, not exact original-paper or a scalar-only MinMax ablation
vsm_boundary: Original VSM call retained. Positive scale-equivariance makes initial VSM gain cancel with its inverse in exact arithmetic; not a VSM benefit test.
inherited_architecture_choices: three equal-width rFFT bands; channel-wise LayerNorm; one outer FAM residual
standard cosine offset/beta cap; not a reconstruction of paper Table 5
repetitions: one seed initially; not five-fold CV
